name: humanizer
description: Agent skill that removes signs of AI-generated writing from text
one_liner: An AI add-on that rewrites AI-sounding text so it reads like a real person wrote it, without changing the facts.
buyer: A content marketing agency producing large volumes of AI-drafted blog posts and social copy that currently reads as obviously robotic and needs to sound human before publishing.
business_use_cases: A marketing agency runs every AI-drafted client blog post through it before publishing, so client-facing copy doesn't sound like a chatbot wrote it.
A student or professional uses it to clean up AI-assisted writing (emails, cover letters, reports) so it reads naturally rather than screaming 'AI-generated.'
A newsletter writer who drafts fast with AI uses it as a final polish step to match their personal voice using a sample of their past writing.

money_ideas.idea: Wrap it in a simple paid web app or browser extension aimed at students and marketers who don't want to run it themselves.
Offer it as a bundled 'final polish' add-on inside an existing AI content/writing SaaS product.

steal_this: This weekend, build a one-page tool: paste AI text in, get humanized text out, charge a small per-use or monthly fee, and market it directly to college students and content marketers.
